description: This file implements a Twitch message monitor that processes incoming messages, routes them to agents, and handles replies. It manages connection setup, message handling, access control, and reply delivery within a Twitch chat integration.

methods.name: processTwitchMessage
methods.description: Processes an incoming Twitch message, resolves routing, formats the message, updates session info, and dispatches a reply pipeline.

methods.name: deliverTwitchReply
methods.description: Sends a reply message to Twitch chat, handling markdown stripping and error management.

methods.name: monitorTwitchProvider
methods.description: Main exported function that sets up the Twitch message monitoring, connection, message handling, and cleanup.
